title: Prime Minister shares Sanskrit Subhashitam emphasizing on virtues of dignity and humility
body_text:
The Prime Minister, Shri Narendra Modi, shared a Sanskrit Subhashitam emphasizing on the virtues of dignity and humility:
"वत्सराजोऽपि तं प्राप्तं प्रदत्तोपायनं नृपम्।
प्रीत्या सम्मानयामास शूरा हि प्रणतिप्रियाः॥"
The verse underscores the noble tradition of welcoming others with dignity and extending respect and warmth to those who approach with humility.
The Prime Minister posted on X:
